## What changed

Describe the datasets, locations, states, or indexes changed.

## Verification

- [ ] I linked the dataset-nomination issue or explained why this is an update only
- [ ] The entry path is `<dataset>/<version>/README.md`
- [ ] Catalogue lifecycle (`D`/`P`/`E`) and operational readiness are both correct
- [ ] Language identifiers use ISO 639-3 plus ISO 15924
- [ ] Normalized statistics are reproduced integers or `null`, not estimates presented as exact
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/build_indexes.py`
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/build_indexes.py --check`
- [ ] New or changed locations have a verification date
- [ ] Evaluation-only data is clearly marked
- [ ] License/access, privacy/PII, quality, safety, and contamination status are stated
- [ ] No credentials, signed URLs, or sensitive row content are included
